description: Route a task to the most relevant skills. An LLM (Llama-3.3-70B via GitHub Models) generates fresh skill candidates, then a local orbital classifier ranks each into a celestial class (planet/moon/trojan/asteroid/comet/irregular) and returns the top matches with full markdown bodies, classification metadata, physics signature, and decision rule. ⚠ Each call typically takes 5–15 s. Returns at most `limit` skills (default 5).

task.description: Task / question / context. Up to 800 chars.

name: route_task
